hero.linha: Group A · Green or Blue tariff · free or regulated market

ajuda.distribuidora: It is the company that sends your electricity bill. The name is at the top of the bill, next to the state abbreviation.
ajuda.mercado: If your company buys energy from an energy retailer and the utility bill only shows TUSD (the network charge), choose Free. If you pay everything on that bill, choose Regulated.
ajuda.modalidade: Look on the bill for the field Modalidade tarifária (tariff modality) or Tarifa (tariff): it will say Azul (Blue) or Verde (Green). If the bill has two contracted demands, one for peak and one for off-peak, it is Azul. If it has only one, it is Verde.
ajuda.contrato: It is not on the electricity bill: it is in the contract with your energy retailer. A fixed price in R$/MWh is Flat price. If the contract is flexible or the price changes every hour, choose Hourly.
ajuda.contratada: On the bill, look for Demanda Contratada Ponta or Demanda Contratada P (contracted peak demand), in kW. If you cannot find it, leave it blank.
ajuda.medida: On the bill, look for Demanda Medida Ponta, Demanda Máxima P or Demanda Registrada Ponta (measured peak demand), in kW.
ajuda.consumo: On the bill, look for Consumo Ponta or Energia Ativa Ponta (peak consumption), in kWh. Type the number as it appears on the bill.

notas.contrato: Reduction handled by First Law with the utility
notas.contrato_assumido: we assume the contract equals the measured demand
notas.contrato_acima: Your contract looks higher than needed; the reduction down to {teto_contr_kw} kW does not depend on the battery
notas.restricao: Cut limited by the battery's energy. Continuous peak loads call for a 3 to 4 h battery; we assess it in the full assessment.
notas.por_hora: With an hourly or flexible contract: + {faixa}
notas.investimento: First Law is paid with part of this value

estados.indisponivel: We do not have {concessao}'s tariffs for the {mercado} market in the {modalidade} modality yet. Send the bills and we calculate with your tariff.
estados.abaixo_minimo: Below {demanda_minima_kw} kW, sizing is case by case. Send the bills and we reply within 5 business days.
estados.acima_teto: For {d_max_kw} kW at peak, the physical maximum is {teto_mwh} MWh per month. Check that you used only the Consumo Ponta column.
estados.nao_reduz: With these numbers the battery does not reduce your bill. Send the bills so we can assess it.
estados.falha: The simulator did not load. Reload the page or send the bills and we calculate it for you.
estados.contratada_abaixo_minimo: A contracted demand below {demanda_minima_kw} kW is not a Group A contract. Check the value on the bill or leave it blank.
estados.invalido: Type only the number, in {unidade}, as it appears on the bill.

sim.aria_valor: Value generated on your bill: {valor} per month

faz.legenda_celular: Peak 6 pm to 9 pm, charge 1 am to 9 am. Dashed line: no battery. Solid line: with battery.
faz.curva_aria: Chart of the plant's demand over the day. Without a battery, demand rises to 1,900 kW at peak, 6 pm to 9 pm. With a battery, charged from 1 am to 9 am and discharged at peak, measured demand drops to 900 kW.

i1.p: It discharges during the three peak hours. Measured demand drops, you contract less and stop paying overrun charges.

i2.p: It charges off-peak and gives the energy back at peak. On the Green tariff, every MWh moved out of the peak stops paying the utility's peak tariff. In the free market, add the price difference of each hour, according to your contract.

i3.h3: Keeps the plant running when the grid goes down
i3.p: While the generator starts, the battery carries the load. No line stoppage.
